method: Read-only web extraction of workshop-owned pages on 26 October 2026. Text retrieval can reflect the tool's stated crawl cache; no forms or messaging actions were performed.
verification_boundary: These are features and claims published by each business, not independently verified credentials, review authenticity, delivered workmanship, availability, prices or booking completion.

sources.summary: Mercedes-only positioning; named technician profiles; workshop imagery; model guides; displayed reviews; XENTRY, genuine-parts and warranty claims. Address and opening hours are published. Service, pricing and warranty links accompany quote/call/WhatsApp actions.
Public model-tier minor/major prices include parts and labour, exclude VAT, and depend on engine/type. An advisor confirms the exact quote. Different from a universal Mercedes service price.

Repair-specific service navigation and technician/genuine-parts claims. Dubai Al Quoz2 and Abu Dhabi branches are listed with map/contact links. Booking and WhatsApp calls to action are visible; transparency is claimed without an on-page itemized fixed-price table.

Mercedes maintenance/repair and model coverage; experience claims; branches and model/service links; instant-quote messaging. Appointment form requests contact/vehicle information. One oil-warning FAQ answer visibly repeats unrelated steering text, a quality caution rather than a pattern to copy.

Detailed service inclusions, diagnostic reports and parts-options explanation. Experience/certification claims and conditional warranty terms are published. Navigation links to repair categories, warranty, appointments and quote requests.

Two Al Quoz locations and phone/WhatsApp contacts are published. Appointment form includes model, year, kilometers, optional VIN and requested date/time; staff confirmation is described. No form was submitted.

Dedicated oil scope, displayed from-AED200 engine-oil/filter price excluding 5% VAT, final diagnostic confirmation, calculator, oil-labeled gallery, related Mercedes links, workshop address and appointment/WhatsApp actions. Image provenance, oil specification, warranty and duration are unverified business claims; no purchase or quote was requested.
